children: ELBIT SYSTEMS AWARDED $235 MILLION CONTRACT TO SUPPLY EXTRA-MR ROCKETS AND PULS LAUNCHERS TO A EUROPEAN COUNTRY
UNDER CONTRACT, ELBIT SYSTEMS WILL SUPPLY THE MEDIUM-RANGE VARIANT OF THE COMPANY’S EXTRA SUPERSONIC ROCKET SYSTEM
CONTRACT WILL BE PERFORMED OVER A PERIOD OF THREE YEARS
CONTRACT ALSO INCLUDES THE DELIVERY OF PULS LAUNCHERS, ADDITIONAL ROCKET-ARTILLERY-RELATED PLATFORMS, AND INTEGRATED LOGISTICS SUPPORT
